scope: Eight requested actual current40b AIR/N4 dynamic consumer regressions. Existing committed collector, fixture, Jest config and assertions unchanged; supplemental fs/CJS byte observer and serial runner are independently frozen outside repo. No native rebuild/mock/browser/public activation. Not checkpoint39 historical qualification.

excluded_case.reason: Separate known second-app AIR_E_APP_CLOSED seam, not one of the eight requested actual dynamic regressions

capture_and_delivery_limits: Actual collector/Jest stdout/stderr, native raw, receipts, before/after manifests and auxiliary launch/read records are bound to exact raw ZIP members below.
Only the first auxiliary wrapper terminal stdout is missing; its launch JSON is retained but is not original stdout. No missing stream is reconstructed.

The supplemental observer captures regular pathname-based fs/CJS reads under repo, including Jest discovery scanning. These are observed read paths, not all executed modules. Numeric file descriptors, paths outside repo and non-files are outside this supplemental hook scope.

Existing duplicate collector inputs/ copies remain local and are hash-referenced to archived source bytes; generated jest-cache/ is excluded as generated test cache, not claimed archived input evidence.
Evidence is stored in exact Library archives, not inserted into Git; source Git identity remains unchanged. No cross-generation lifecycle expansion was run.

auxiliary_stdout_gap.missing_auxiliary_stream: Supplemental Python run-case.py terminal stdout was not redirected to a file; the tool display was truncated. Full original auxiliary stdout bytes are unavailable and are not reconstructed.
auxiliary_stdout_gap.not_a_substitute: 01-launch-result.json retains the full structured launch data but is not claimed to be the missing original stdout.
auxiliary_stdout_gap.future_runs: 02 onward supplemental driver stdout/stderr are directly redirected to files.
auxiliary_stdout_gap.scope: Auxiliary terminal-output gap only; no claim of zero missing evidence. No rerun relabeled as original.
